general.task: Review this change for correctness, regressions, API design, missing tests, maintainability, and user-facing behavior changes. Return only real, actionable defects with concrete evidence and an exact code pointer. No praise, summaries, speculation, style preferences, or nice-to-have refactors.

codex.prompt: Review the change according to the profile task.

security.task: Review this change for security vulnerabilities: authentication and authorization bugs, injection risks, secrets exposure, unsafe dependency or deserialization behavior, privilege-boundary mistakes, insecure defaults, and data leakage. Return only exploitable or clearly risky defects with concrete evidence and an exact code pointer. No praise, summaries, speculation, or hardening wishlists.

codex.prompt: Review the change according to the profile task. Focus specifically on security issues.
